about: Guided recordings that label what the wearer was doing, so raw earclip PPG can be used to build and test on-device beat (IBI) detection. Shared by the dashboard, Android and iOS: run the blocks in order, exactly as written. See protocol/guided/README.md for the field meanings and the marker-id scheme.

tones.announce: soft two-note chime: an instruction is starting
tones.go: single bright tone: the labelled block starts now
tones.cue_high: short high beep: do the cued action now
tones.cue_low: short low beep: do the cued action now

protocols.title: Core: still, foot tap, chewing, talking
protocols.summary: About 7 minutes, seated. The four everyday conditions that matter most for an earclip, with a still block at both ends to check drift.

blocks.label: settle
blocks.prompt: Clip on your earlobe. Sit still and breathe normally while the sensor settles.
blocks.say: Sit still and breathe normally while the sensor settles.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still. Hands in your lap, look ahead, breathe normally.
blocks.say: Next, sit still. Hands in your lap, look ahead, and breathe normally.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Keep your head and upper body still.
blocks.say: Next, tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Keep your head and upper body still.

blocks.label: foot_tap
blocks.prompt: Tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Head and upper body still.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: chew gum steadily on both sides. No gum? Chew as if you had some.
blocks.say: Next, chew gum steadily, on both sides. If you have no gum, chew as if you did.

blocks.label: chew
blocks.prompt: Chew steadily on both sides.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: talk out loud. Describe your day, read something aloud, or count.
blocks.say: Next, talk out loud. Describe your day, read something aloud, or count.

blocks.label: talk
blocks.prompt: Keep talking out loud.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still again. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.
blocks.say: Next, sit still again. Hands in your lap, and breathe normally.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Done. Thank you.
blocks.say: That is the whole protocol. Thank you.

protocols.title: Full: everyday motion plus cued actions
protocols.summary: About 17 minutes. Adds cued head turns, jaw clenches and swallows, arm movement, paced breathing, standing up and sitting down, walking in place, and touching the clip.

blocks.label: settle
blocks.prompt: Clip on your earlobe. Sit still and breathe normally while the sensor settles.
blocks.say: Sit still and breathe normally while the sensor settles.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still. Hands in your lap, look ahead, breathe normally.
blocks.say: Next, sit still. Hands in your lap, look ahead, and breathe normally.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Keep your head and upper body still.
blocks.say: Next, tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Keep your head and upper body still.

blocks.label: foot_tap
blocks.prompt: Tap one foot steadily, about twice a second. Head and upper body still.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: chew gum steadily on both sides. No gum? Chew as if you had some.
blocks.say: Next, chew gum steadily, on both sides. If you have no gum, chew as if you did.

blocks.label: chew
blocks.prompt: Chew steadily on both sides.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: talk out loud. Describe your day, read something aloud, or count.
blocks.say: Next, talk out loud. Describe your day, read something aloud, or count.

blocks.label: talk
blocks.prompt: Keep talking out loud.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: on each beep, turn your head to one side and back. Alternate left and right.
blocks.say: Next, on each beep, turn your head to one side and back. Alternate left and right.

blocks.label: head_turn
blocks.prompt: On each beep, turn your head and come back to center.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: on each beep, clench your jaw firmly for about two seconds, then relax.
blocks.say: Next, on each beep, clench your jaw firmly for about two seconds, then relax.

blocks.label: jaw_clench
blocks.prompt: On each beep, clench your jaw for about two seconds, then relax.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: on each beep, swallow once.
blocks.say: Next, on each beep, swallow once.

blocks.label: swallow
blocks.prompt: On each beep, swallow once.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.
blocks.say: Next, sit still. Hands in your lap, and breathe normally.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: move your arms and hands. Reach, gesture, type or scroll on your phone. Keep your head still.
blocks.say: Next, move your arms and hands. Reach, gesture, type, or scroll on your phone. Keep your head still.

blocks.label: arm_move
blocks.prompt: Keep moving your arms and hands. Head still.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: breathe with the tones. In when the tone rises, out when it falls. Six breaths a minute.
blocks.say: Next, breathe with the tones. In when the tone rises, and out when it falls.

blocks.label: paced_breath
blocks.prompt: Breathe in with the rising tone, out with the falling tone.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: on each beep, stand up; on the next beep, sit down.
blocks.say: Next, on each beep, stand up. On the next beep, sit down.

blocks.label: stand_sit
blocks.prompt: On each beep, change position: stand up, then sit down.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: stand up and walk in place at an easy pace.
blocks.say: Next, stand up, and walk in place at an easy pace.

blocks.label: walk_in_place
blocks.prompt: Walk in place at an easy pace.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit down. On each beep, lightly touch the clip, then let go.
blocks.say: Next, sit down. On each beep, lightly touch the clip, then let go.

blocks.label: clip_touch
blocks.prompt: On each beep, lightly touch the clip, then let go.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still for the last block. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.
blocks.say: Next, sit still for the last block. Hands in your lap, and breathe normally.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still. Hands in your lap, breathe normally.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Done. Thank you.
blocks.say: That is the whole protocol. Thank you.

blocks.say: Sit still while the sensor settles.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: sit still.
blocks.say: Next, sit still.

blocks.label: rest
blocks.prompt: Sit still.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: tap your foot.
blocks.say: Next, tap your foot.

blocks.label: foot_tap
blocks.prompt: Tap one foot steadily.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Next: turn your head on each beep.
blocks.say: Next, turn your head on each beep.

blocks.label: head_turn
blocks.prompt: On each beep, turn your head and come back.

blocks.label: transition
blocks.prompt: Done.
blocks.say: Done.
